profile.headline: Cyber Security Leader | Lead Software Engineer at Ensemble
profile.summary: Innovative and results-driven Technology Leader, Security Architect and Software Engineer with 30+ years of experience across diverse industries including healthcare, financial, Department of Defense, and government. Recognized expert in Cybersecurity. Proven ability to lead large technical teams, architect secure systems, and deliver complex and cutting-edge solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered HL7 intake broker for EIQ Clear Patient Access system using C#, .NET Core, and Azure Cloud. Used DevOps, DevSecOps, and SAFe Agile practices and methods.

- Developed and extended custom real-time rules engine for automation of denial prevention.

- Promoted from contractor to full-time; nominated for Ensemble’s 2024 and 2025 Year-End Awards.

- Received 2026 Q1 Difference Maker Award

positions.title: Principal Technologist
positions.description:
- Software engineering for companies in the business network of Infinite Peaks Holdings, a venture capital company.
- Reverse engineered and rebuilt legacy medical systems with incomplete source code.
- Tech: C#, ANSI C, Intel Fortran, ASP.NET, Microsoft SQL, AWS, ElasticSearch.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Azure · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
- Owner of a consulting and software development company specializing in computer security incident handling, forensics, and complex event processing for legal companies (Holland & Hart, Lathrop & Gage)
- Developed experimental open source solutions for SIEM, SOAR, Intrusion Visualization, and Forensics.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Azure · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Principal Security Architect
positions.description:
- Led a Managed Security Architecture team for SIEM solutions across multiple platforms.
- Designed custom log parsing, alarms, and compliance packages for top-tier enterprise clients.
- Performed wireless penetration testing, rogue AP detection, bug sweeps and PCI-driven RF solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer Level Four
positions.description:
- Developed offensive RF cyber systems for electronic warfare (Top Secret/SCI).
- Built solutions with SDR, MITM tools, Linux embedded devices, and custom network simulators.
- Achieved NG Challenge Award JUN 2012, TAP award for SEP 2012, and NG Cyber Technology Award 2014

positions.title: Senior Knowledge Engineer
positions.description:
- Core contributor to LogRhythm’s SIEM knowledge base, reporting and alarms.
- Developed initial regulatory compliance content (PCI, HIPAA, SOX, FISMA, etc.) and performed frequent public speaking at security conferences as directed by the CTO and Marketing.
- Instrumental in LogRhythm’s repeated Gartner MQ recognition for regulatory compliance.

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description:
- Delivered pen testing, source code audits, ISO 17799 policy development, and incident response as a contractor to a diverse set of clients desiring short term assistance. 80% travel.
- Oversaw security certifications for voting systems and architected managed security offerings.

positions.title: Java Developer / Contractor
positions.description: - Maintained Java Swing applications for Juniper’s Network Security Manager, enhancing functionality for Firewalls, Intrusion Prevention, Routers, and VPN devices.

positions.title: Product Director
positions.description:
- Designed security components for Innerwall’s distributed agent technology.
- Performed penetration tests for clients to ensure robust security measures.
- Managed product comparisons and created a computer security matrix for over 100 companies.
- Collected vulnerabilities and exploits for use in penetration tests, enhancing overall security protocols.

positions.title: NORAD Software Security Architect
positions.description:
- Designed NORAD’s future computer security architecture and vision for the ISC2 contract.
- Led security software design for one of the most famous of the United State’s military bases.
- Headed implementation and testing team of 34 people.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed three products (HostCHECK, NetCHECK, Vulnerability Database) from concept to finish, enhancing quality iterations, wrote vulnerability checks for Qualix, Inc.'s vulnerability scanner.
- Conducted multiple penetration tests for clients, utilizing experience to enhance existing products and company toolsets.
- U.S. Patent Recipient, Superior Performance Award 1997.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and released Trident Data System’s Hostguard software package for a 5000+ user network administration team in a high-security environment.
- Obtained security clearance for United States Air Force position and received Trident Data System's Superior Achievement Award in 1996.
